arxiv-1509-03901.title: Recurrence, rigidity, and popular differences
arxiv-1509-03901.creator: John T. Griesmer
arxiv-1509-03901.description: Abstract . We construct a set of integers S S such that every translate of S S is a set of recurrence and a set of rigidity for a weak mixing measure preserving system. Here “set of rigidity” means that enumerating S S as ( s n ) n ∈ ℕ (s_{n})_{n\in\mathbb{N}} produces a rigidity sequence.

arxiv-2104-05529.title: Rota-Baxter operators on Turaev’s Hopf group (co)algebras I: Basic definitions and related algebraic structures Thanks: * Corresponding author
arxiv-2104-05529.creator: Tianshui Ma *, Jie Li, Liangyun Chen, Shuanhong Wang
arxiv-2104-05529.description: Abstract . We find a natural compatible condition between the Rota-Baxter operator and Turaev’s (Hopf) group-(co)algebras, which leads to the concept of Rota-Baxter Turaev’s (Hopf) group-(co)algebra. Two characterizations of Rota-Baxter Turaev’s group-algebras (abbr. T-algebras) are obtained: one by Atkinson factorization and the other by T-quasi-idempotent elements.

arxiv-2110-03403.title: Disentangling deep neural networks with rectified linear units using duality
arxiv-2110-03403.creator: Chandrashekar Lakshminarayanan, Amit Vikram Singh
arxiv-2110-03403.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Chandrashekar Lakshminarayanan, Amit Vikram Singh. Despite their success deep neural networks (DNNs) are still largely considered as black boxes. The main issue is that the linear and non-linear operations are entangled in every layer, making it hard to interpret the hidden layer outputs. In this paper, we look at DNNs with rectified linear units (ReLUs), and focus on the gating property (‘on/off’ states) of the ReLUs.

arxiv-2209-09273.title: Gravitational Optomechanics: Photon-Matter Entanglement via Graviton Exchange
arxiv-2209-09273.creator: Dripto Biswas, Sougato Bose, Anupam Mazumdar, Marko Toroš
arxiv-2209-09273.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dripto Biswas, Sougato Bose, Anupam Mazumdar, Marko Toroš. The deflection of light in the gravitational field of the Sun is one of the most fundamental consequences for general relativity as well as one of its classical tests first performed by Eddington a century ago. However, despite its center stage role in modern physics, no experiment has tested it in an ostensibly quantum regime where both matter and light exhibit non-classical features.

arxiv-2308-08032.title: Using Artificial Populations to Study Psychological Phenomena in Neural Models
arxiv-2308-08032.creator: Jesse Roberts, Kyle Moore, Drew Wilenzick, Doug Fisher
arxiv-2308-08032.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jesse Roberts, Kyle Moore, Drew Wilenzick, Doug Fisher. The recent proliferation of research into transformer based natural language processing has led to a number of studies which attempt to detect the presence of human-like cognitive behavior in the models. We contend that, as is true of human psychology, the investigation of cognitive behavior in language models must be conducted in an appropriate population of an appropriate size for the results to be meaningful.

arxiv-2312-15871.title: Option pricing under stochastic volatility on a quantum computer
arxiv-2312-15871.creator: Guoming Wang, Angus Kan
arxiv-2312-15871.description: Abstract We develop quantum algorithms for pricing Asian and barrier options under the Heston model, a popular stochastic volatility model, and estimate their costs, in terms of T-count, T-depth and number of logical qubits, on instances under typical market conditions. These algorithms are based on combining well-established numerical methods for stochastic differential equations and quantum amplitude estimation technique.

arxiv-2403-16871.title: Conformal Off-Policy Prediction for Multi-Agent Systems
arxiv-2403-16871.creator: Tom Kuipers, Renukanandan Tumu, Shuo Yang, Milad Kazemi, Rahul Mangharam, and Nicola Paoletti
arxiv-2403-16871.description: Abstract Off-Policy Prediction (OPP), i.e., predicting the outcomes of a target policy using only data collected under a nominal (behavioural) policy, is a paramount problem in data-driven analysis of safety-critical systems where the deployment of a new policy may be unsafe.

arxiv-2412-20227.title: LLM Reasoning Engine: Specialized Training for Enhanced Mathematical Reasoning
arxiv-2412-20227.creator: Shuguang Chen, Guang Lin
arxiv-2412-20227.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance in various natural language processing tasks but face challenges in mathematical reasoning, where complex problem-solving requires both linguistic understanding and mathematical reasoning skills. Existing approaches to address this challenge often rely on ensemble methods and suffer from the problem of data scarcity in target domains.

arxiv-2501-00798.title: Make Shuffling Great Again: A Side-Channel Resistant Fisher-Yates Algorithm for Protecting Neural Networks
arxiv-2501-00798.creator: Leonard Puškáč, Marek Benovič, Jakub Breier, Xiaolu Hou
arxiv-2501-00798.description: Abstract Neural network models implemented in embedded devices have been shown to be susceptible to side-channel attacks (SCAs), allowing recovery of proprietary model parameters, such as weights and biases. There are already available countermeasure methods currently used for protecting cryptographic implementations that can be tailored to protect embedded neural network models.

pmc-10554169.title: OR05-03 Treatment Of Parathyroid Neoplasia By Pharmacologic cdk4/6 Inhibition
pmc-10554169.creator: Jessica Costa-Guda, Justin Bellizzi, Sindy Gorka, Christina Titarenko, Andrew Arnold
pmc-10554169.description: Disclosure: J. Costa-Guda: None. J. Bellizzi: None. S. Gorka: None. C. Titarenko: None. A. Arnold: None.Parathyroid carcinoma (PC) is a rare, life-threatening malignancy. Despite relatively slow growth, recurrent or metastatic disease is typically incurable and often fatal due to cumulative complications of sustained elevation of parathyroid hormone (PTH) and accompanying hypercalcemia.

pmc-10772981.title: Pyoderma gangrenosum developed from aggravated pemphigus foliaceous after dog bite
pmc-10772981.creator: Jun Ho Kwak, Chan Ho Na, Bong Seok Shin, Min Sung Kim, Hoon Choi
pmc-10772981.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). athergy phenomenon in which lesions occur in the sites of previous trauma.2 In addition, pyoderma gangrenosum is accompanied by systemic diseases, such as Crohn’s disease or inflammatory colitis, rheumatoid arthritis, and hyperthyroidism.3 Although numerous reports indicate that pyoderma gangrenosum is associated with systemic diseases, 4 case reports on the association of pyoderma gangrenosum with skin diseases, especially blistering disorders, are very rare.

pmc-11329643.title: Females increase reproductive investment when mated to less sexually attractive males in a serially monogamous fish
pmc-11329643.creator: Tingting Lin, Xin Liu, Siping Li, Dong Zhang, Fengyuan Shen, Keji Jiang
pmc-11329643.description: Reproductive investment decision is an integral part of life-history theory. Differential allocation hypothesis predicts that females should increase investment when mated to high-quality males, conversely, reproductive compensation hypothesis predicts that females should increase investment when mated to low-quality males. Empirical research dominantly focuses on polygamous species and rarely on serially monogamous species.

pmc-11432408.title: Dysbiosis in Human Urinary Microbiota May Differentiate Patients with a Bladder Cancer
pmc-11432408.creator: Julie A Vendrell, Simon Cabello-Aguilar, Romain Senal, Elise Heckendorn, Steven Henry, Sylvain Godreuil, Jérôme Solassol, Georg C Hutterer
pmc-11432408.description: Recent interest in noninvasive diagnostic approaches has highlighted the potential of urinary microbiota as a novel biomarker for bladder cancer. This study investigated the urinary microbiota of 30 bladder cancer patients and 32 healthy controls using a specific NGS protocol that sequences eight hypervariable regions of the 16S rRNA gene, providing detailed insights into urinary microbiota composition.

pmc-11470590.title: The environmental effects of non-invasive cardiac imaging
pmc-11470590.creator: Kelsey Gardiner, Kate Hanneman, Rebecca Kozor
pmc-11470590.description: The healthcare sector is a major contributor to the universal climate footprint, of this a significant proportion is attributable to medical imaging and further to dedicated cardiac imaging. The increasing availability and utility of cardiac imaging techniques for prognosis, diagnosis and management raises concerns for the impact of these investigations on the environment.

pmc-11508877.title: Cough-Induced Detrusor Overactivity—Outcome after Conservative and Surgical Treatment
pmc-11508877.creator: Anna-Sophie Villiger, Mihaela Madalina Fluri, Diana Hoehn, Anda Radan, Annette Kuhn, Tomasz Rechberger
pmc-11508877.description: Background/Objectives: The most common variant of mixed urinary incontinence is stress-induced urge urinary incontinence with the correlating urodynamic findings of cough-induced detrusor overactivity (CIDO). This prospective study assessed the clinical outcomes and leakage improvement among patients with CIDO following conservative or surgical treatment.

pmc-11716241.title: Household Crowding and Neurocognitive Performance in a Cohort of Middle‐Aged Latina Women: The CHAMACOS Maternal Cognition Study
pmc-11716241.creator: Jacqueline M Torres, Lucia Calderon, Katherine Kogut, Maria Teresa Rodriguez, Monica Romero, Lizari Garcia, Yesli Perez Rocha, Nadia Rojas, Liliana Paloma Rojas‐Saunero, Brenda Eskenazi, Hector M González
pmc-11716241.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundHousehold crowding is a longstanding focus of public health research; there is growing interest in its impact on dementia risk. In the US, household crowding is prevalent among low‐income immigrant communities that have historically been excluded from dementia research.

pmc-12471253.title: Therapeutic Potential of Astrocyte-Derived Extracellular Vesicles in Post-Stroke Recovery: Behavioral and MRI-Based Insights from a Rat Model
pmc-12471253.creator: Yessica Heras-Romero, Axayácatl Morales-Guadarrama, Luis B. Tovar-y-Romo, Diana Osorio Londoño, Roberto Olayo-González, Ernesto Roldan-Valadez
pmc-12471253.description: Astrocyte-derived extracellular vesicles (ADEVs) have emerged as promising neuroprotective agents for ischemic stroke. In this study, we evaluated the therapeutic potential of hypoxia-conditioned ADEVs (HxEVs) administered intracerebroventricularly in a rat model of transient middle cerebral artery occlusion (tMCAO). Serial magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) with diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) was performed at 1, 7, 14, and 21 days post-stroke.

pmc-12526456.title: Analysis of the Phenolic Compounds, Volatile Profile, and Evaluation of the Antioxidant Activity of 18 Different Varieties of Honey from the Italian Market
pmc-12526456.creator: Doaa Abouelenein, Laura Acquaticci, Eleonora Spinozzi, Agnese Santanatoglia, Gulzhan Khamitova, Ahmed M Mustafa, Marco Cespi, Silvia Preziuso, Luca Bianchi, Filippo Maggi, Giovanni Caprioli, Felipe Moura Araújo da Silva, Rita De Cássia Saraiva Nunomura
pmc-12526456.description: The aim of this study was to present a comprehensive analysis of honey varieties from different botanical origins, focusing on their phenolic compounds’ composition, volatile profiles, and antioxidant activity. We simultaneously identified and quantified 37 bioactive compounds, including anthocyanins, flavonols, flavones, flavan-3-ols, proanthocyanidins, and phenolic acids, across various honey samples by HPLC-MS/MS.

pmc-12948650.title: Monitoring of Metabolic Disorders Through Electro‐Sensing of Riboflavin by Novel Super‐Conductive Silver Ink Modified Paper
pmc-12948650.creator: Rokhsareh Ebrahimi, Mohammad Hasanzadeh, Nasrin Shadjou
pmc-12948650.description: Riboflavin (RIB), or vitamin B2, plays a key role in cellular protection against oxidative stress, and its deficiency can cause severe physiological complications, including metabolic disorders, photosensitivity, anaemia, growth delay and gastrointestinal problems. Rapid and accurate quantification of RIB in real biological samples is important.

pmc-13203242.title: N-Carbamylglutamate Improves Production Performance and Muscle Growth by Regulating Protein Digestive Function and Muscle Protein Synthesis in Broiler Chickens
pmc-13203242.creator: Lingping Zhao, Shitu Tan, Wanqiao Zhang, Pei Mao, Xiaohong Wu
pmc-13203242.description: Simple SummaryThe sufficient digestion and absorption of dietary proteins in the digestive tract have positive effects on production performance in broiler chickens. Improving protein digestibility is a strategy for increasing the yield and quality of broiler meat in poultry production.

pmc-13253733.title: C-reactive protein to albumin ratio as a predictor of early postoperative wound complications in patients undergoing posterior lumbar spine surgery
pmc-13253733.creator: Tao Niu, Haoran Zhang, Peng Xie, Shibin Shen, Haoran Huang, Zhenggang Zhou, Bin Wang, Jianlin Ma
pmc-13253733.description: ObjectiveEarly postoperative wound complications remain a significant challenge following posterior lumbar spine surgery. The C-reactive protein to albumin ratio (CAR) has emerged as a promising biomarker for systemic inflammation and nutritional status. This study aimed to evaluate the predictive value of preoperative CAR for postoperative wound complications in patients undergoing posterior lumbar spine surgery.

pmc-13556087.title: Biomechanical advances in oblique lateral lumbar interbody fusion using different interbody cages
pmc-13556087.creator: Yermike Bieshanbieke, Fei Xie, Baofeng Yan
pmc-13556087.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Oblique lateral lumbar interbody fusion (OLIF) is a minimally invasive spinal fusion technique that has gained increasing popularity in the treatment of lumbar degenerative diseases. The interbody cage is a critical implant in OLIF procedures, and its material properties, structural design, dimensions, placement location, and combination with supplemental fixation strategies play a decisive role in determining immediate postoperative stability, fusion rate, restoration of disc height and lumbar lordosis, stress distribution, and the risk of adjacent segment degeneration (ASD).
